sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु वचनम् भरद्वाजेन राघवः ।प्रत्युवाच शुभम् वाक्यम् रामः सर्व हिते रतः ॥२-५४-२३॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu vacanam bharadvājena rāghavaḥ ।pratyuvāca śubham vākyam rāmaḥ sarva hite rataḥ ॥2-54-23॥

translations.english: Rama, ever devoted to the wellbeing of every one, heard Bharadwaja and replied to him with these auspicious words:
